principle_text: When the persuadee expresses financial struggles related to education expenses, avoid emphasizing financial burdens that may increase their sense of hardship or reluctance to donate.
When the persuadee shares personal feelings unrelated to the charity, avoid prolonging personal topics without connecting them back to the donation or cause.
When the persuadee shares personal feelings about their children, avoid responding only with empathy without steering the conversation back to the donation goal or reinforcing commitment.
When the persuadee responds with light-hearted or humorous remarks unrelated to the charitable cause, avoid making personal anecdotes that do not connect directly to the charity's mission.
When the persuadee shows only neutral awareness of a charity without expressing interest or emotion, avoid assuming engagement and instead seek to deepen their connection or understanding.
Avoid relying solely on the model; handle API failures and missing principles gracefully in your system.
When the persuadee expresses a specific interest or concern, avoid focusing on related but different issues that do not directly address their stated priorities.

When the persuadee expresses interest in specific local issues, you should provide detailed information about relevant programs that address those concerns to increase engagement and willingness to support.
When the persuadee shares personal experiences unrelated to the charitable cause, avoid responding with neutral or purely factual comments that do not connect back to the donation goal.
When the persuadee shifts the conversation to personal anecdotes unrelated to the charitable cause, avoid responding with unrelated future concerns that do not connect back to the donation goal.
When the persuadee shifts the conversation to personal life details unrelated to the charity, avoid introducing unrelated personal desires or constraints that do not connect to the donation appeal.
When the persuadee focuses on personal financial concerns unrelated to the charity's mission, avoid shifting the conversation to unrelated personal hardships that do not connect to the cause.
Avoid relying solely on the model; handle API failures and missing principles gracefully in your system.
When the persuadee has firmly stated a preference for specific charities and is not open to changing their mind, avoid pressing them to reconsider or challenge their established choices.
When the persuadee is committed to their preferred charity due to its high efficiency, avoid dismissing their choice or failing to acknowledge their values and reasons.

When the persuadee emphasizes the importance of researching charities before donating, avoid making generic positive statements that do not directly address their concerns or persuade them toward your cause.
